verdict.rationale: AWS IAM documents OIDC identity providers that connect external CI such as GitHub Actions to AWS resources, and assuming a role issues temporary session credentials. Roles carry no long-term passwords or access keys, and AWS recommends federation over IAM users. That covers the core of keyless, short-lived CI access. Missing for 10: an end-to-end walkthrough in the evidence (trust-policy and claim-condition setup), evidence for workload identity for services running on AWS, guardrails that prevent long-lived access keys from being created, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
